mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_session (id, title, scenario, summary, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{scenario}, #{summary}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_session SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chat_session WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM chat_session WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY update_time DESC
